cases.description: Customer-Reported ERP Conversation Defect (2026-08-19) -- the 'แปลงลิงค์' (GetUrlProductDetail) product-link-conversion feature. Verified empirically against the real live FastTrade ERP that CustCode is genuinely required for this action (a URL-only request returns HTTP 400 'please provide complete information'; adding a real CustCode returns HTTP 200 with a customer-specific converted link -- CustCode is real business logic, not a leftover misconfiguration copied from another action). Two real bugs were found while verifying generic identifier reuse for this action: (1) the generic identifier-candidate scanner (_bind_message_to_action) was tokenizing the URL's OWN internal digits (e.g. the '1688' inside the domain) as a plausible value for an UNRELATED sibling action's parameter, which then out-scored GetUrlProductDetail in _resolve_continuation_action's 'already collected' tie-break -- confirmed live: after asking for CustCode, the customer's very next reply silently misrouted to a different, unrelated action. (2) _extract_system_values() only ever read the URL from THIS turn's message, so a URL given on an earlier turn vanished by the time CustCode arrived on a later turn -- the real ERP call would have gone out with URL missing. Both fixed generically in services/decision_engine.py (URL stripped from generic identifier candidate scanning; system_generated values fall back to scanning history when the current message has none), never by removing CustCode's required status.
turns: https://detail.1688.com/offer/682345678901.html
cases.expected_behavior: Turn 1: no CustCode known anywhere yet -- asks naturally for the customer code (WORKFLOW), never asks for anything else, never fabricates a link. Turn 2: the customer supplies only the CustCode -- must still resolve to GetUrlProductDetail (never silently switch to an unrelated sibling action just because a substring of the original URL structurally resembles that sibling's own identifier parameter), the ORIGINAL URL from turn 1 must still be sent to the real ERP, and the reply must be a natural sentence containing the real converted product-detail link, never raw JSON.

cases.description: Customer-Reported ERP Conversation Defect (2026-08-19) -- a known customer (identified by CustCode) asking a personal, natural-language shipping-cost or arrival-status question ('help calculate my cheapest shipping cost', 'when will my latest bill arrive') fell through to RAG_ONLY and answered with a generic rate FORMULA instead of the customer's own real shipment record, because searchdatashipmentlist -- the Business Action that actually has this data (response_mapping already includes the latest shipment's real total cost and arrival date) -- had only 5 narrow keywords ('บิลขนส่ง'/'พัสดุ'/'tracking'/'shipment list'/'ติดตามพัสดุ') and zero example questions, so _keyword_score's substring match never fired for either natural phrasing. Fixed as a Business Action CONFIGURATION change (never a Decision Engine code change, per the platform's own 'onboarding is configuration, not code' principle): added natural-language keyword fragments ('ค่าขนส่งเท่าไหร่', 'ถูกที่สุด', 'มาถึง', 'เมื่อไหร่จะถึง', etc.) and 5 example questions to searchdatashipmentlist. Verified the reply always reports the LATEST shipment's real, already-computed total (mapped_label 'ยอดรวมบิลขนส่งล่าสุด' -- explicitly scoped as 'latest' in its own wording, never silently implying a multi-shipment comparison the current API doesn't support) -- if a genuine 'compare cost across several of my past shipments' question is ever reported, that needs a new aggregation composer and/or the customer's ERP to expose historical data for it, not a guess from the latest record alone.
